name: Tabora
summary: First-party English and Swahili discovery verified Tabora Municipal Council as a local land/plot-administration custodian and the Tanzania Ministry of Lands/e-Ardhi system as the national land-cadastre custodian. No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus unchanged polygon response, schema or CRS was qualified.
queryAndRequestOutcome: All executed discovery queries and bounded GET attempts are recorded in city-1781-tabora.json. The e-Ardhi page was reachable but account-oriented; the land-rent portal was not queried for unsafe ownership-related fields; Tabora municipal and land-rent direct requests failed DNS from this host. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS verification disablement, or protected query was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if independently source-proven
